'''R2-6N''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] who worked in the facility's garage in [[the Retreat]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The Retreat was a settlement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cholganna/Legends|Cholganna]], created by the surviving crew members of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] [[Sa Nalaor/Legends|''Sa Nalaor'']], which crashed on to the planet whilst trying to escape [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]] at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. R2-6N aided [[Ninan]], the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] survivor in charge.
